name: @recoder/t3-session-bridge
description: The Wave-side seam named by docs/RECODER-T3CODE-COMPOSITION.md section 4 ('packages/contracts + client-runtime ... The single session protocol for Wave blocks'): a typed, Promise-based RecoderSessionRpcClient wrapping @t3tools/contracts's WsRpcGroup wire schema over a plain WebSocket to the local recoder environment server (the forked t3 apps/server, renamed `recoder`). Built directly on effect/rpc + effect/socket rather than @t3tools/client-runtime's EnvironmentSupervisor stack -- see this package's src/effect-client.ts header comment for why. Nothing outside this package and packages/t3-bridge imports @t3tools/* directly (see docs/T3CODE-FORK.md section 3).
